summary: A 43-year-old Utah climber took a 50-foot lead fall on the Scenic Cruise route in Cruise Gully, breaking his ankle, and rappelled to the base of the route; Black Canyon rangers performed the park's first-ever short-haul rescue, flying him to the South Rim helicopter landing pad.
location: Scenic Cruise route, Cruise Gully, Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP
responding_agency: NPS Black Canyon rangers; Mesa Verde helitack (short-haul training)
notes: NPS morning-report entry dated 2020-06-17 (source: Montrose Daily Press). First short-haul rescue conducted within Black Canyon.
